name.description: the extension's name in the browser's list of extensions and on its toolbar button; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

description.message: Hands downloads from the browser to Mister Download Manager.
description.description: the extension's description in the browser's list of extensions; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

menu.description: command in the browser's right-click menu on a link, picture, video or sound; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

video_download.description: the button over a video on a web page that downloads it; verb; short (it sits on the video)

video_more.description: the small arrow next to the Download video button that opens its menu (read aloud by screen readers)

video_hide_here.description: menu command of the download button over a video: hide the button on this video only

video_never_site.description: menu command of the download button over a video: never show the button on this web site again

video_settings.description: menu command of the download button over a video: opens its settings in Mister Download Manager

video_sent.description: shown briefly on the download button after it was clicked; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

video_failed.message: Mister Download Manager isn't installed or didn't start
video_failed.description: shown briefly on the download button when the app could not be reached; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

video_drag.message: Drag to move it along the video's edge
video_drag.description: tooltip of the download button over a video: it can be dragged to another place on the video's edge

menu_selected.message: Download selected links with Mister Download Manager
menu_selected.description: command in the browser's right-click menu on selected text: download the links in the selection; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

menu_all.message: Download all links with Mister Download Manager
menu_all.description: command in the browser's right-click menu on a page: download the links of the whole page; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_connected.description: the toolbar button's status when the browser reaches the app; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_connected_version.description: the toolbar button's status when the browser reaches the app, with the app's version number; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_paused.message: Paused: downloads stay with the browser
status_paused.description: status when the user switched off taking downloads in the toolbar button's popup

status_not_installed.message: Mister Download Manager isn't installed, or its browser integration isn't set up
status_not_installed.description: status when the browser can't find the app's connection; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_forbidden.message: Mister Download Manager doesn't accept this copy of the extension
status_forbidden.description: status when the app refuses this copy of the extension (another copy is installed, or it came from another store); keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_not_running.message: Mister Download Manager didn't start in time
status_not_running.description: status when the app was started for a download but didn't answer in time; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_host_failed.message: The connection to Mister Download Manager failed
status_host_failed.description: status when the connection to the app broke off (often security software blocking it); keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_too_large.message: This download's details were too large to hand over
status_too_large.description: status when a download carried too much data (very large cookies) to give to the app

status_update_app.message: Update Mister Download Manager to use everything this extension offers
status_update_app.description: status when the app is older than the extension; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_take.description: check box in the toolbar button's popup: on, downloads go to the app; off, the browser keeps them

popup_proxy.message: Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension
popup_proxy.description: switch in the toolbar button's popup: on, the app downloads through the same proxy the browser uses (one a VPN or proxy extension sets); the browser then asks once to allow reading it

popup_proxy_title.message: Mister Download Manager then downloads through the same proxy as this browser. The browser asks you once to allow it; turning this off takes that back.
popup_proxy_title.description: tooltip of the switch Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_exclude_site.description: button in the toolbar button's popup: leave this web site's downloads to the browser from now on

popup_excluded.message: Downloads from $site$ stay with the browser
popup_excluded.description: shown in the toolbar button's popup after the site was excluded

popup_open.description: button in the toolbar button's popup; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_options.description: button in the toolbar button's popup: open the app's Options

popup_help.description: link in the toolbar button's popup to the help page

popup_support.description: link at the foot of the toolbar button's popup to the creator's GitHub Sponsors page (MDM is free; this is an optional donation)

popup_fix.description: link under a connection problem in the toolbar button's popup, to the help page's section for it

popup_alt.message: Hold Alt while clicking a link to let the browser download it.
popup_alt.description: hint in the toolbar button's popup; Alt is the keyboard key

popup_media.description: heading in the toolbar button's popup over the list of the videos, sounds and streams the current web page has loaded

popup_media_none.message: No video or sound found on this page yet. Play it, then open this again.
popup_media_none.description: shown in the toolbar button's popup when the current web page hasn't loaded any video, sound or stream yet

popup_media_download.description: button beside a video, sound or stream in the toolbar button's popup: download it with the app; verb; short

popup_media_protected.description: shown instead of the Download button beside a copy-protected (DRM) stream in the toolbar button's popup: it can't be downloaded; short

popup_media_live.description: beside a stream in the toolbar button's popup: it is a live broadcast (no fixed length); short

video_off.message: The download button is off on this site
video_off.description: shown briefly on the download button over a video when the app's settings keep the button off on this web site

video_drm.message: Protected video: it can't be saved
video_drm.description: shown briefly on the download button when the video is copy-protected (DRM) and no tool can download it
